newsitem.title: UK: London stocks start easier, trading volume light.
newsitem.headline: London stocks start easier, trading volume light.

text.p: UK shares were moderately lower in early trade on Monday as market makers marked down prices after Wall Street's 47-point decline last Friday, dealers said.
A weaker U.S. Treasuries and gilts market also unsettled early investor sentiment as did growing political uncertainties ahead of the looming UK general election.
"There isn't any panic this morning. Just a mark down," the head of trading at a major securities house said.
"Considering Wall Street had a bad week, the FTSE hasn't done too badly."
The FTSE 100 was down 15.2 points at 4,293.1 by 0836 GMT.
